column3: NKJV has “who does not follow us” as well as “because he does not follow us,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text has only “because he was not following us.”
Close to the Greek; “a work of power” is rendered “a miracle.”
NKJV has “in My name,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “in the name, because you are Christ’s.”
Close to the Greek; “crippled” is rendered “maimed,” and “unquenchable” as “that shall never be quenched.”
This verse is absent from the critical text; NKJV includes it following the Textus Receptus (“where ‘Their worm does not die …’”).
NKJV adds “into the fire that shall never be quenched,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text ends with “cast into hell.”
This verse is absent from the critical text; NKJV includes it following the Textus Receptus (“where ‘Their worm does not die …’”).
NKJV adds “and every sacrifice will be seasoned with salt,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text has only “everyone will be salted with fire.”
